This '''unnamed [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] prior to owning the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] destroyed the freighter by landing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] directly on top of it during a botched raid by Bossk on a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] colony on [[Gandolo IV/Legends|Gandolo IV]].
